reading.body:
James Lankford's AI record in this data is mostly one bill: 12 of 15 events are votes on S. 2296, and the three AI measures he sponsored or cosponsored all date to September or October 2026.

The S. 2296 votes cluster on a single day, 2025-10-09, when he voted on eight amendments and on passage. He voted Yea on final passage and on two amendments, and Nay on six others. Earlier procedural votes on the same bill, in September and on 2025-09-10, were all Yea. The record shows a senator working a bill through amendment votes rather than a spread of separate AI legislation.

The three later measures are narrower. S. 5471, the AI Systems Transparency Act, carries him as cosponsor. S.Res. 896, which he sponsored, ties religious freedom and authoritative texts to transparency in AI systems. S. 3062, the GUARD Act, concerns age verification and responsible dialogue. All three are transparency, speech, or access measures, not compute, data center, or power measures.

What this does not show is money. The summary says the page covers AI company and AI-focused political committee contributions, but no contribution appears among the 15 events. It also does not show committee assignments, floor statements, or any position on the grid and power constraints that shape AI buildout. The dates are status dates for bills, not introduction dates, so the timeline is when measures last moved, not when they began.

summary: Every dated AI event this site holds for James Lankford: bills sponsored or cosponsored, recorded votes on AI bills, and money from AI company and AI-focused political committees, newest first. 15 events.
